caption: The drawing features two identical white swan figures positioned side by side, each facing outward from the center. The swans are depicted with wings raised and necks extended forward; their beaks are open. Both swans are placed atop golden, bowl-shaped bases that have a rounded foot. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects, decorations, or markings, giving the drawing a symmetrical and uncluttered composition. The swans and their bases are centrally located within the image, leaving ample empty space around them. The color palette consists primarily of white for the swans and gold for the bases, with some light shading to indicate depth and texture on the bodies and wings of the swans.
title: Architectural Carving
